title: Know Before You Ship: Personalisation and Customer Obsession in Ecommerce Webinar on Sept 30
summary: Join the live webinar on September 30 about personalizing ecommerce marketing without losing brand authenticity.
body_markdown:
Hi all


👋


If your ecommerce team is trying to personalise at scale without your brand starting to feel like a bot wrote it, this webinar is worth 40 minutes of your time.


Know Before You Ship: Signal, Decision-Making, and Customer Obsession in Ecommerce


📅


September 30, 2026 | 2PM BST | Live panel + Q&A Hannah Bonney (Moonpig) and Dekel Moyal (Global-E) are sharing how they decide when a personalised recommendation actually helps someone, and when it just feels like a brand that doesn't know them. Moderated by Abla Alami at Mixpanel. Free to attend, and your questions go straight to the panel live.


[Register here](https://events.mixpanel.com/know-before-you-ship-ecommerce-emea/?utm_source=customerslackchannels&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=WBN-26-08-12-KnowBeforeYouShip-EMEA-FM&utm_content=slack-promo-2) .
